The event provides a platform for participants to ideate, collaborate, experiment and develop innovative solutions to real-world challenges. raw.details:
About The Event

  • REFRACT 1.0 marks the inaugural edition of a 30-hour national-level hackathon.

  • The event is organised by the SPIE OPTICA Student Chapter, University of Engineering and Management, Kolkata, in collaboration with the UEMK Space Observatory.

  • Event Dates: 30th–31st January 2027

  • REFRACT 1.0 aims to bring together creative thinkers, developers, researchers and aspiring innovators from across the country to transform ideas into impactful solutions.

  • The event provides a platform for participants to ideate, collaborate, experiment and develop innovative solutions to real-world challenges.

  • With six diverse innovation tracks, the hackathon encourages interdisciplinary exploration across emerging technologies, engineering, scientific research and creative problem-solving.

  • Join our Official Discord Server for updates & team formation: https://discord.gg/DMhmUEJtK

Themes & Innovation Tracks

Participants can develop solutions under any one of the following six tracks:

  1. Photonics & Optical Innovation: Innovate with light. Build real-world solutions using optical sensors, lasers, fiber-optic communication, smart displays, solar devices, or optical imaging systems.
  2. AI & Intelligent Systems: Deploy ultra-low latency neural architectures, autonomous multi-agent workflows, computer vision algorithms, real-time sensor intelligence, and local edge inference models.
  3. Robotics & IoT (Hardware Track): Bring hardware to life. Build autonomous robots, smart gadgets, automated control systems, and connected IoT devices using microcontrollers, sensors, and actuators.
  4. App & Game Development: Create high-performance mobile applications, immersive web platforms, interactive game mechanics, real-time 3D rendering engines, and next-generation digital experiences.
  5. Space Technology: Create solutions inspired by the cosmos. Work on satellite systems, orbital tracking, space data processing, CubeSat hardware, or astronomy-related applications.
  6. Open Innovation: Ideas beyond boundaries. Defy traditional tech silos with unconstrained multidisciplinary inventions, wildcard solutions, and unconventional prototypes solving high-impact problems.

Event Format & Process

REFRACT 1.0 Will Follow A Hybrid Format Consisting Of Two Phases:

  1. Phase 1: Online Preliminary Round:

    • Participants Must Register And Submit Their Project Ideas Or Proposals.

    • Submissions Will Be Evaluated By The Organising Team And/Or Designated Evaluators.

    • Shortlisted Teams Will Qualify For The Offline Finale.

  2. Phase 2: Offline Grand Finale

    • Selected Teams Will Participate In The 30-Hour Offline Hackathon.

    • Participants Will Work On Developing And Refining Their Proposed Solutions.

    • Teams Will Present Their Projects Before The Judging Panel.

    • Winners Will Be Determined Based On The Evaluation Criteria.

Event Details

  • Event Dates: 30th–31st January 2027

  • Venue: University Of Engineering And Management, Kolkata (New Town)

  • Mode: Hybrid (Online Idea Submission Preliminary Round + Offline Finale)

Eligibility

  • The Hackathon Is Intended For Students And Aspiring Innovators Interested In Technology, Engineering, Research And Problem-Solving.

  • Participants From Diverse Academic Backgrounds And Institutions Are Encouraged To Apply.

  • Teams Must Register Through The Official Registration Portal.

  • Participants Must Provide Accurate Information During Registration.

  • Shortlisted Teams Must Be Available To Attend The Offline Finale At The Designated Venue.

Rules & Guidelines

  • Participants Must Register Within The Stipulated Registration Period.

  • All Team Members Must Be Registered Through The Official Registration Process.

  • Each Team Must Select One Of The Six Designated Innovation Tracks.

  • Submitted Projects Must Be Original And Must Not Infringe Upon Any Third-Party Intellectual Property Rights.

  • Plagiarism, Impersonation, Misrepresentation Or Submission Of Previously Completed Projects As Entirely New Work May Lead To Disqualification.

  • Teams Must Adhere To All Submission Deadlines And Instructions Communicated By The Organising Committee.

  • Shortlisted Teams Must Participate In The Offline Finale As Per The Schedule Shared By The Organisers.

  • Participants Are Expected To Maintain Professional Conduct And Follow The Event Guidelines Throughout The Competition.

  • The Organising Committee Reserves The Right To Disqualify Participants Or Teams Found Violating The Rules.

  • Decisions Made By The Judging Panel And Organising Committee Regarding Evaluation And Results Will Be Final.

Evaluation Criteria

Projects Will Be Evaluated On The Basis Of The Following Broad Parameters:

  • Innovation & Originality: Uniqueness And Creativity Of The Proposed Solution.

  • Technical Implementation: Quality Of Execution And Effective Use Of Technology.

  • Problem Relevance: Understanding Of The Problem And Practical Applicability.

  • Feasibility & Scalability: Potential For Real-World Implementation And Future Development.

  • Presentation & Demonstration: Clarity Of Communication, Demonstration And Overall Project Understanding.
